g.text: Customer360 on Kubernetes — runtime (pod) view · local overlay
Namespace customer360 on a kind cluster. Every app pod gets envFrom c360-config (ConfigMap) + c360-secrets (Secret);
data pods read their DB / Redis / MinIO credentials from the same Secret. Arrows show runtime traffic, not build-time wiring.
kind maps host ports → NodePort → Service
Data tier & one-shot Jobs come from the in-cluster-data component — local overlay only. The vks overlay drops them and points the app at GreenNode managed vDB + vStorage.
